change_summary: Added an audit-only runner that replays the accepted A+B stack on the three fixed snapshots, isolates trend_instant_failure losers, and measures repeated entry-context subfamilies plus winner collateral if a future fix zeroes a context.
hypothesis: The accepted stack's dominant repeated loser family is trend_instant_failure, and its internal subfamilies can be measured reproducibly without changing strategy logic.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260426_003_trend_instant_failure_audit.json. Exact context keys did not repeat across windows, but broader axes did: Technology + reduced_risk + 6.00ATR accounted for 4 of 7 instant-failure losses across all three windows, while plain full-risk contexts accounted for 84.6% of gross instant-failure loss. The cleanest no-collateral contexts were Energy | full_risk | plain | 4.50ATR, Financials | full_risk | plain | 4.02ATR, and three reduced-risk Technology contexts with zero same-context winners. Commodities | full_risk | plain | 7.00ATR is not a safe filter candidate because it would also kill 6 winners worth $17712.43. LLM entry-archive coverage remained 0/7 and news coverage was missing on 7/7 instant failures, so semantic explanation is still a measurement gap, not a rejected mechanism.
